# (sha256 d381fb1ae2d4a548a1a4a5f0c24f72efcb522d1da75d4b87610af2e7f913ee63) with src/linux/generic/syscallent-common.h
# (sha256 01699c19c2089f7dea45234884cc8fc0529293591d882c01dacccc8627252e39). Cloud, Pupa and Adam run strace 6.8 (Oct 17).
